VOTED BEST ASIAN RESTAURANT ON THE GULF COAST by the Mobile Press Register! 
 An Authentic Taste...
 Here at Teak House Thai Restaurant we believe in the total Thai dining experience.  
 We serve fresh quality food in a comfortable atmosphere at prices everyone can enjoy. With an 
 extensive knowledge of Thai tradition and a rich palette of spices, our skilled chefs have created 
 some of 
 the most delicious flavors of classical Thai cooking. 
 
 ...of fine Thai Cuisine
 The taste of Thai food lies in the ingredients. We use only the freshest ingredients in all our selections and make each dish to order. 
 Our aromatic dishes not only taste good, but are good for you as well.  
Our chefs use only 100% vegetable oil, 
 which is trans-fat-free, and we have a wide variety of vegetarian dishes. With so much to choose from, 
 we guarantee to satisfy the palette and excite the senses. 
 Please call us in advance to arrange for large or special parties. 
 We are located in Daphne, Alabama on Highway 98 East, across from Target at the new M&A Center. For driving directions, click on the "Directions" button at the top this page.
 We look forward to your visit! 
 Come experience the flavor of authentic Thai Cuisine.
